card.name: Linking words inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a symptom noun (pain, tenderness, out of breath) in lists of symptoms. The next word is usually an activity or body movement such as walking or eye movement.

modes.label: Pain plus linking word
modes.description: The word 'while' or 'with' right after 'pain' leads into an activity or movement.

modes.label: Comma or 'or' in symptom series
modes.description: A comma or 'or' between symptoms in a list, such as muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness.
modes.example: Advise patients to report any unexplained muscle pain, tenderness<<,>> or weakness.

modes.label: Out of breath
modes.description: The word 'breath' after 'get out of' in a description of symptoms.
